name: Danshi Kouishitsu de Deatta Shoujo Honoka
original_name: 男子更衣室で出会った少女ほのか
source:
1x-year-old Honoka-chan is fascinated by men's thingies.
She hides out in the locker room of a public swimming pool.
Her plan seems to be dressing up as a boy, but it's so obvious.
Let's have some fun with the frisky lolita.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126024.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一岁的小穗香对男士用品很着迷。
她躲在公共游泳池的更衣室里。
她的计划看似是女扮男装，但又是那么明显。
让我们一起来享受一下活泼的洛丽塔吧。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126024.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
